facts.text: Sam expressed appreciation for Evan's support and presence during a difficult time.

evidence.quote: Thanks for always being there, Evan. It means a lot.
Sure, Sam. I'm here for you. We gotta stick together, especially now.

facts.text: Evan mentioned that he had a health scare and was recovering, with doctors stating that everything was fine.

evidence.quote: I'm doing well now. Doctors said everything is fine, but it taught me the value of life.

facts.text: Sam shared that he had recently watched a 'feel good' movie and mentioned it as his go-to choice for enjoyment.

evidence.quote: I did get this yesterday. It's been my go-to 'feel good' flick.

facts.text: Evan emphasized the importance of having supportive friends during tough times, stating that they make life easier.

evidence.quote: Tough times are way easier with friends we can rely on. We've got each other!
